description: Publish a file WITHOUT carrying it through this tool call. Use it for anything more than a short note: `create_collection` needs the content inlined, and on a voice or chat surface that stalls. This call is metadata only - `filename`, and optionally `title`, `mime`, `tags` - and returns an address, a one-use token and the exact request to make. Then POST the file's RAW BYTES to that address from your code sandbox with the `X-Upload-Ticket` header (not base64, not multipart, not JSON - the body is the file). The ticket works once, expires in minutes, and publishes to the workspace you called from, so nothing about the request you send afterwards can change where it lands.

filename.description: filename is what the file will be called in Kythene, e.g. "handover.md".

idempotencyKey.description: idempotency_key makes a retried upload safe: the same key publishes once.

mime.description:
mime is the content type, e.g. "text/markdown". Guessed from the filename
 when you leave it out.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name from
 list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

tags.description:
tags are the projects and labels to file it under, exactly as publish takes
 them.

title.description: title is the collection's title. Defaults to the filename.

name: create_upload_ticket
title: Create upload ticket
